name: Pia♥Carrot e Youkoso!! G.O. ~Grand Open~
original_name: Pia♥キャロットへようこそ!!G.O. ～グランドオープン～
source:
Jun'ichi falls in love with a restaurant waitress. He starts working there to become close with her. One day, he meets Ayano, his old friend, by chance and tells her that he works at a restaurant. A few days later, when he goes to the restaurant, he meets Ayano again. It seems she starts working there as well...

[From HimeyaShop]
